stayType: Holiday home ownership park (no holiday lets)
accommodation: Lodges and caravans for holiday home owners only, per operator page.
beachAccess: About one mile east of Widemouth Bay (We Are Cornwall listing).
overview: Widemouth Fields is a lodge and caravan park in countryside about a mile inland from Widemouth Bay, a few miles from Bude. Operator Aria Resorts now presents it as an ownership park and directs visitors to its holiday-home sales site rather than taking holiday bookings.
surfTripFit: Not currently a bookable base for visiting surfers, as the operator says it no longer takes holiday guests.
gaps: widemouthfields.co.uk blocked fetching. Older listing describes pods, touring pitches, outdoor pool and dogs welcome, but the operator page says holiday guests are no longer taken; consider removing or relisting as ownership-only.
